        super(Model, self).__init__()

    C: T.handle,

    T.func_attr({"global_symbol": "matmul_kernel", "tir.noalias": True})

    K = T.int32()

    B_ = T.match_buffer(B, [K, N], dtype="float16")
    C_ = T.match_buffer(C, [M, N], dtype="float16")

                sum[0] += T.cast(A_[vi, k], "float32") * T.cast(B_[k, vj], "float32")
